text:
deploy-bot: CONFIG-ONLY 'sparrow-slim' scheduled for change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. rollout plan: canary 4% -> 30% -> 100%. keys touched: per-tenant caps, request_timeout_ms, routing_weights, batch_window_ms, kv_prefill=true. :rocket:
lena: dropping the config diff for quick review:
```json
{
  "per_tenant": {"floor_rps": 0.4, "ceiling_rps": 40},
  "request_timeout_ms": 11000,
  "batch_window_ms": 7,
  "routing_weights": {"primary": 0.92, "fallback": 0.08},
  "kv_prefill": true
}
```
priya: quick flag  why 11s timeout? we usually run 10s.
mark: we replayed slow-first-token variants, 11s reduces client-side retries + downstream 429s.
sre-oncall: set auto-rollback: p95 > 260ms OR error_rate > 0.6% for 4m -> immediate rollback. also enable per-host override to disable kv_prefill if mem/swap rises. page #incidents on triggers.
deploy-bot: auto-rollback and per-host override gates configured. canary -> 4% now.
lena: 4% steady for 5m: p95=160ms (baseline 158ms), error_rate=0.05%, mem=54%. no alerts.
deploy-bot: advancing to 30%.
sre-oncall: HOLD  observing increased swap on shard gpu-03. pausing ramp and applying override: kv_prefill=false on gpu-03.
priya: logs show agent spawned 6 prefill workers on gpu-03 despite global=2 (race). will hotfix agent to respect host override.
deploy-bot: override applied to gpu-03, hotfix queued. restarting shard gracefully.
mark: restart complete, gpu-03 mem back to 59%, swap cleared. ready to resume.
deploy-bot: resuming ramp to 30% then 100% in stages. monitors: p95=172ms, error_rate=0.08%, mem headroom OK.
lena: please capture 15min request sample for regression evals and save to /internal/evals/sparrow-slim.
priya: sample captured and uploaded. running quick diffs for text continuity and latency distribution.
sre-oncall: set temporary aggressive alerts for next 30m. prefer pause+override over full rollback unless thresholds breach.
deploy-bot: final rollout to 100% complete at 1780000600. no rollback triggered. summary saved and release-note PR opened: 'sparrow-slim: adjusted per-tenant caps, 11s timeout, batch window 7ms, kv prefill opt-in with per-host overrides, auto-rollback gates.'
mark: nice work. will follow up with short retro if any late regressions surface. closing thread after PR merges. :white_check_mark:
